Python: why does 2 + "2" give a TypeError?¶{{c1::+ adds numbers or concatenates strings, so it is unable to mix them}}
column2: Numbers mix with numbers freely — 2 + 2.5 works fine.

column1: Python: what is returned when you don't return a value?¶{{c1::None}}
column2: Every call hands something back; if no return runs, that something is None.

column1: Python: when you write print instead of return in a function, what do you get?¶{{c1::None}}
column2: print only shows output; the function itself hands nothing to the caller.

column1: Python: what is the difference between return and print?¶{{c1::return hands a value to the caller that is usable, storable and testable, whereas print paints pixels for the human}}
Python: what does any() do?¶{{c1::takes a stream of booleans and gives back one}}
column2: Many answers in, one verdict out.

column1: Python: when is any() True?¶{{c1::when at least one boolean is True}}

Python: why do you use any(ch.isdigit() for ch in pw) and not pw.isdigit() to check if there is a digit in pw (a password)?¶{{c1::because pw.isdigit() checks if the whole string is a digit, whereas the other checks per character}}
Python: what does 2 + 2.5 return, and what type?¶{{c1::4.5}} · {{c1::float}}
column2: The int gets promoted; numbers mix freely.
